about_the_game:
Hellrifters isn’t just about survival — it’s about enduring the abyss, growing stronger run after run, and completing brutal missions until you can finally turn Hell’s fury against itself.

Start alone against the horde and unlock new heroes until your squad grows into a four-soldier death machine. Command your team in this tactical survivors roguelite, where every battlefield becomes your proving ground against grotesque demons, lethal hazards, and unforgiving objectives.

Each level-up offers meaningful choices: select free basic upgrades or invest points in powerful premium options to transform your squad into an unstoppable force.

Wield Special Abilities like Bullet Time, Teleport, Decoy, and Deathball to seize control of the chaos. Go offensive or defensive — it’s your call, your style.

Build synergies across classes, weapons, and damage types to forge an unstoppable squad. Face grotesque demons, deadly hazards, and destructible arenas — every drop of blood you spill leaves its mark.

Key Features

Squad-Based Survivors-Like

  • Start with 1 hero, expand to 4 — each with unique stats, weapons, and a signature upgrade path.

  • Lead your team in a precision-based “bead chain” formation that demands positioning, timing, and coordination.

Destructive Physics Combat

  • Turn destruction into a weapon — shattered enemies and rubble become projectiles that cascade chaos through demon ranks

Fully Destructible Arenas

  • Cover shatters. Gore, scorch marks remain for the entire run.

Synergy Build System

  • Earn Upgrade Modules to permanently boost stats, unlock abilities, or add passives.

  • Combine permanent upgrades with mid-run class-specific level-ups for explosive builds.

8 Unique Classes

  • Each with its own weapon type, stats, and one exclusive level-up category — changing how you play every run.

Strategic Slow Motion

  • Browsing abilities slows time for clutch decision-making.

Revive System

  • Find and destroy Hellshrines and Hellpumps to speed up the revival of fallen heroes.

Combo XP System

  • Keep kill streaks high to stack XP bursts.

Tiered Achievements

  • 3-tier challenges grant XP for mastering weapons, abilities, and combos.

Meta Progression & Module Forging

  • Level up heroes to earn perks and upgrade equipment, boosting base stats and expanding module slots permanently.

  • Collect and dismantle modules to forge new ones — choose tier, rarity floor, and category, then pick one of three randomized results.

Layered Objectives

  • Survive and complete nearly all secondary objectives to advance; finish every challenge for bonus rewards.

Diverse Enemy Roster

  • From swarming critters to hulking brutes, each demon has unique behavior and exploitable weaknesses.

Hazards & Hellscapes

  • Jetpack over lava, sludge, and other dangers — or fall in. Your choice.

Progression Loop

Battle through 10 brutal Rifts, each split into escalating sub-levels.

  • Start with one hero, unlock more as you conquer.

  • Collect upgrade modules to grow stronger and open new build options.

  • Face harder enemies and hazards with each step deeper.

  • Complete secondary challenges for rare rewards.

Every run makes you stronger. Whether you win or fall, Hell remembers.

content_descriptors.notes: Stylized, fast-paced combat with frequent stylized gore and enemy dismemberment of demonic foes (exaggerated debris). No graphic violence toward human characters. May not be suitable for all audiences.

short_description: Lead a squad of heroes on suicide missions into Hell’s rifts. Face grotesque demons, shatter battlefields and weaponize gore in this squad-based survivors roguelite with physics-driven combat. Upgrade, synergize, survive — every run makes you deadlier. Only the strongest return from abyss.
